notes.title: -50% OFF ON BLACK FRIDAY! UNTIL DECEMBER 4TH!
notes.content:
Celebrate Black Friday in Nocturne Island Obscuria with a 50% discount, and with the zombie mode coming out soon, it's the best time to buy the game!
Offer available until December 4th.

We are aware that some players are experiencing issues with the opening video and credits, as well as some unexpected bugs. A patch will be released today to fix these and improve everything. Thank you.
